steps: 1. Open inventory and set **Character Preview Lighting** to **Vanilla**. Note its brightness, background, camera and interface.
2. Without leaving inventory, select **Dim**, then **Dark**; compare the progressively darker preview lighting while the same scene stays in place.
3. Return to **Vanilla** and compare with the baseline. Close/reopen inventory and confirm the selected value persists and original lighting is restored.
4. Enter a mission and inspect gameplay lighting as an unrelated-world control.
assertions: Only the inventory preview lighting changes. Dim/Dark do not replace its scene, camera or package; Vanilla restores the prior lighting exactly and gameplay lighting is unaffected.
R part: shading callback installed on the preview world only, exposure 0.65/0.40, restored on Vanilla/exit, mission world untouched; darkness itself: screenshot mean-luminance diff.
